notes.title: The History of Magic Tower:Beginning - "Racing" mode launched!
notes.content:
0511 update content

1. A new "Racing" mode has been added! The content is a [speedrun] mode based on the difficulty of [normal]. When players clear the game within 40 minutes, they can obtain the new achievement "He Who Strikes Fast Survives".

The "Racing" mode can be set with the third button ("Options"/"选 项") on the game title screen.

2. Fixed the problem where some achievements could not be triggered.

3. The [pop-up] has been modified to make the game more smooth.


The above are the main contents of this update. Please refer to the game for details.

The game will continue to be updated. Have a great time playing!

notes.title: "The History of Magic Tower:Beginning" complete version released!
notes.content:
0126 Update

1. Add the ending story, as well as a new BGM and a game CG corresponding to the story.

2. Add an epilogue, including a new BGM, game screenshots and the credits.

3. Changed the BGM of the tutorial.

4. New optional language: English. 
If you need to change the language, you can set it in the game without re-downloading the game.

5. Fixed an issue where weapons could be equippedand and the substitute could not be retrieved in some cases when using [Subs] in "Marcia mode".

The above is the main content of this update, the specific subject to the game.

The game will continue to update, I wish you a happy game!

notes.title: [1101 Update] - "Marcia Mode" completed + "Game Achievements" enabled!
notes.content:
1101 update

1. Enabled the "Steam Game Achievements", with a total of 61 achievements for players to challenge.

This includes 51 regular mode achievements, 9 [Marcia] mode achievements and 1 [hard] mode achievement.

The icon color of each achievement is determined by the difficulty and particularity of the achievement itself.

2. Complete the plot of [Marcia] mode and add a new BGM with plot.

3. Fixed an issue where enemy damage was not correct in [Marcia] mode using the [Substitute].

4. Modified the settings of some maps in [Marcia] mode:

- 2F changed [Mattock] to [Antidote].


The above is the main content of this update, the specific subject to the game.

The game will continue to update, I wish you a happy game!

notes.title: [0910 Update] - Added "Marcia Mode"!
notes.content:
"The History of Magic Tower: Beginning" 0910 update

1. Added "Marcia Mode", in this mode, added a controllable character: Marcia.

This character would be unlocked after completing the game once on any difficulty. (No plot for the moment)

2. Added the beginning plot map, and added some explanations about the plot background.

3. Significantly changed the "Beginner Tutorial". Added some helpful text descriptions for new players and optimized text display.

Added "Item Tutorial" and "Skill Tutorial", as well as 6 maps related to them.

4. Fixed an issue where enemy damage was not correct during battle process in "Easy Mode".

5. Optimized the mouse "Find Way To" function, and repaired the problems existing in the original function.

6. Changed some map Settings:

- Main 1F Moved Wind Compass to the start map and added a room containing potions.

- Main 15F added a "key merchant", who can buy several yellow keys at a low price.

- Basement 18F added a "recycling key merchant" who can sell yellow keys at a high price.


The above is the main content of this update, the specific subject to the game.

The game will continue to update, I wish you a happy game!
